# ClauseIQ

> AI-powered legal contract analysis, risk evaluation, and clause interrogation.

## Overview
ClauseIQ is a web platform for analyzing legal PDF contracts, identifying potential commercial and legal risks, and providing cite-backed answers to clause-specific inquiries.

## Key Capabilities
- In-memory PDF contract text extraction with OCR fallback
- Automated clause extraction and risk categorization (High, Medium, Low)
- Two-stage RAG conversational question answering with exact clause citations
- Secure authentication with Google OAuth 2.0 and email verification
